race.comment: SEASIDE BOULEVARD (11) is a smart filly who was just too good in her heat here on Tuesday when she raced wide early but worked to the front and went on to cruise home by 9m. That win saw her unbeaten at this distance. A back row draw means she may be relying on some luck but she has the talent to overcome that and win. WATERMAIN LADY (8) continued a winning streak from last campaign when she overcame a similar draw for a resuming win in the heats, her fourth success on the trot. That took her strike rate here to 50 per cent and she has enough gate speed to go forward. Fitter and looks a threat. SEASIDE SID (10) closed nicely and got close to WATERMAIN LADY on Tuesday and had won two in a row prior including the Canola Cup. Draws on the second row but scored from there two back at Bathurst and is going well. TUKAHA (2) and LITTLE SASSY BOY (1) were both good on Tuesday and draw to be competitive again.
